contracts_rationale: Bug fixes inside existing commit routing; the only new interface element is the STATUS_WRITE_CHECKOUT_NOT_ON_WRITE_BRANCH refusal code, specified in spec.md FR-002.
friendly_name: Coordination-less status commits take their checkout from the placement seam
purpose_context: Slice 2 of checkout-verdict-agreement-01M7B1GG (#7633): the coordination-less arm of BookkeepingTransaction picks its checkout with a raw holder probe instead of the placement seam. The same run fixes the lanes_with_coord review claim that routes an unchanged WP file to protected main (#7637) and commit_idempotent turning an unchanged staged tree into a rollback (#7648).
purpose_tldr: Coordination-less status commits run where the read door reads, or refuse; review claims and idempotent follow-up commits stop failing on unchanged content.
